email.subject: Lakeview — damaged reading room wall
email.body:
Hi Accounting,

We have about $1,060 in patching and repainting after Ridgeline Drywall's cart hit the finished wall in the Lakeview Library reading room. I told them we'd be issuing a back-charge, but their foreman is disputing it and says another crew made the damage.

Hold this one until I review the daily photos. Don't take it out of their payment yet.

Thanks,
Dana
